question: What is the name of the integrated digital portal launched by the Government of India to streamline Corporate Social Responsibility partnerships for women and child welfare?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PANKHUDI.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Ministry of Women and Child Development launched the PANKHUDI portal to strengthen CSR and partnership initiatives for women and child welfare.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **PANKHUDI is an integrated digital portal launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.**
 
• It aims to streamline CSR contributions and partnerships focused on women and child development.
 
• The platform brings together NGOs, companies, CSR contributors, NRIs, government agencies and individuals.
 
• Portal Features__ 
 __
 
• Registration of contributors and partners
 
• Submission and tracking of project proposals
 
• Defined approval workflows for transparency
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Supported Missions__

 __
 
• Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0
 
• Mission Vatsalya
 
• Mission Shakti
 
 
 
• Operational Framework__
 __
 
• All contributions processed through non-cash modes
 
• Ensures traceability, accountability and transparency
 
• Promotes Jan Bhagidari in governance
 
 
 
• Expected Impact__
 
 
• Benefits over 14 lakh Anganwadi Centres
 
• Supports Child Care Institutions, One Stop Centres and Shakti Sadan
